record_title: Prime-length weight-three conflict-avoiding codes through subgroup index 3200
provenance: A finite certified extension of the uniform subgroup-index range for prime-length weight-three conflict-avoiding codes, combining published analytic bounds with explicit primitive-root coset witnesses for every remaining gap prime.
limitations: Extends the verified consecutive index range only from 3000 to 3200 and relies on the previously reported p<=2^30 computation. Originality is to the best of our knowledge; Ma-Zhao-Shen (2014) was not directly inspected in full, although the later Hsia-Li-Sun papers explicitly describe its conjecture and computational range.
